'''Sayur sop''' is an [[Indonesian cuisine|Indonesian]] [[vegetable soup]] prepared from [[vegetable]]s in [[Chicken meat|chicken]] or [[beef]] [[broth]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://food.detik.com/sup-dan-salad/d-4798354/resep-sayur--sayur-sop|title=Resep Sayur: Sayur Sop|publisher=detikfood|access-date=July 18, 2020}}</ref> It is popular in [[Indonesia]], served as [[breakfast]] or [[lunch]].
